commentary: With benchmark breadth deteriorating to anemic levels of 26 and the Nifty slipping below key psychological supports amid heavy FII distribution exceeding ₹10,000 crore, Stan Weinstein's market discipline dictates extreme defense. In O'Neil's framework, the market is in a confirmed correction. When the general market tide recedes, three out of four stocks eventually roll over, irrespective of chart perfection. Minervini's progressive exposure rules mandate sitting predominantly in cash, keeping position sizes strictly curtailed, and avoiding breakout chasing. Only rare Stage 2 institutional leaders demonstrating explosive CANSLIM earnings acceleration and resilient relative strength deserve watchlist placement until broad breadth confirms a genuine follow-through day.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Market Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above its EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, pressing against the 104.09 neckline pivot with a 2x volume expansion. However, overall base maturity and relative strength remain unproven against the broader tape.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe CANSLIM degradation. Sales collapsed 56.3% YoY and quarterly net profit slumped 25.6% YoY. Operating margins remain razor thin, 3-year average ROE is a meager 3.1%, ROCE languishes at 5.6%, and promoter holding has steadily declined. Zero institutional sponsorship.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A decisive break below 97.24 violates the base support; Minervini discipline enforces cutting losses immediately to preserve capital.

ADFFOODS.technical: SEPA breakout cleared the 20-session high at 331.08 on 2.74x average volume. Price tracks cleanly above upward-sloping EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with an RSI of 56 indicating unexhausted upside momentum.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Top-line expanded 25.9% YoY driven by packaged food exports. However, EPS growth decelerated to +14.6% in Q1 FY27 from +72.3% in Q4 FY26. While virtually debt-free with a healthy 21.8% ROCE, decelerating profit growth caps CANSLIM leadership rating.
ADFFOODS.risk: Failure below the 309.63 pivot stop invalidates the breakout attempt; execute an immediate exit without hesitation.

AEGISLOG.technical: Textbook Stage 2 power trend; printed three consecutive higher highs and higher lows rebounding off the rising 21-EMA and 50-DMA on heavy accumulation volume with RSI 58 displaying exceptional relative strength.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM leadership profile. Massive EPS acceleration (+42% to +46% to +269% YoY) and +38% top-line growth driven by terminal expansions. Backed by 27.6% ROCE, 22.9% ROE, 30% operating margins, low net leverage, and solid 58.1% promoter backing.
AEGISLOG.risk: A close below the 1383.26 stop breaches the 21-EMA cushion; discipline dictates an immediate exit to preserve gains.

ALICON.technical: High-volume 20-day pivot breakout clearing 870.67 backed by a massive 10.48x volume surge. Moving averages (EMA21, SMA50, SMA200) are sequentially stacked in a bullish configuration with MACD positive.
ALICON.fundamental: Revenue expanded 38.2% YoY and EPS rebounded +20.3% following prior quarters of contraction. However, operating margins remain slim at ~9.5%, three-year average ROE is modest at 8.8%, and EPS growth remains shy of the 25% CANSLIM standard.
ALICON.risk: A reversal breaching support at 790.64 invalidates the volume breakout; cut position immediately to curb downside exposure.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Constructive double-bottom consolidation with neckline pressure building at 953.70. Price is anchored above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200; RSI at 64 reflects solid accumulation without reaching overbought territory.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Powerful turnaround in Q1 FY27 with sales surging 104% YoY and EPS jumping 151% on green packaging demand. Operating margins expanded to ~41%, ROCE reached 29.6%, and debt is negligible, though prior-quarter earnings volatility limits full qualification.
ARROWGREEN.risk: A breach below 849.35 violates the base swing support; Minervini risk protocol requires immediate capital preservation.

ATLANTAELE.technical: Double-bottom base breakout on 3.2x average volume; bullish engulfing real body clearing overhead resistance while trading comfortably above ascending EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 moving averages.
ATLANTAELE.fundamental: Benefiting from grid capex with +47.5% sales and +50.4% net profit growth. Boasts elite return metrics (ROCE 45.3%, ROE 31.7%), an almost debt-free balance sheet, and 87.3% promoter ownership. However, profit growth deceleration from Q4's +70% strictly caps verdict at Watch.
ATLANTAELE.risk: A breakdown below 1804.62 violates the base structure and key swing lows; cut losses ruthlessly.
